test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Study the given pie-chart and answer the question that follows.

The pie-chart shows the number of students (boys and girls) studying in standard 10 of various schools (X, Y, Z in the year 2022). 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85a1bd82d26d8115398fd0dbc62fcac8a6929f88fac43bc6e23958afb4e16037.png] 

What is the difference between the total number of students (boys and girls) in school Y and Z together and the total number of students (boys and girls) in school X and Y together?
solution:
**Solution:**

Total number of students (boys and girls) in school Y and Z together = (30% + 25%) of 3600

55% of 3600

55/100 × 3600 = 1980

Total number of students (boys and girls) in school X and Y together = (45% + 30%) of 3600

75% of 3600

75/100 × 3600 = 2700

Required difference = 2700 - 1980 = 720

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
